title: Area of a Rectangle: Formula, sq ft to sq m, Tiles and Path Problems
seoTitle: Area of a Rectangle: Formula, sq ft & Examples
seoDescription: Area of a rectangle = length × breadth. See worked examples for room size in sq ft and sq m, tiles needed, missing sides, diagonals and path area.
excerpt: Six fully worked examples, from converting a bedroom from sq ft to sq m and counting floor tiles to NCERT-style path sums, plus the unit and perimeter mistakes that cost marks.
